verdict.rationale: Make documents scheduling scenarios (its workflows) as a first-party feature, and the webhooks docs describe recurring scheduled runs: a scenario can be set to process queued webhook requests periodically, every time the schedule criteria are met. This is a true recurring schedule, not a one-off run, though the evidence is mostly a doc heading plus webhook-context snippets. Missing for 10: detail on schedule options (intervals, cron-style or calendar rules), evidence of setting schedules programmatically via the API or MCP server for AI-native use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
